label: Security & Compliance
blurb: A shelf for reading a change before it ships: secrets in text the user supplies, untrusted instructions hidden in a prompt or a tool result, and the evidence a control asks for. Dependency-audit notes already live on Dev Tools; this shelf files that output when a control needs it. Nothing here is a penetration test or a certification.

subshelves.label: Secrets
subshelves.description: Reports kinds and line numbers. It does not store the secret.

subshelves.label: Prompts
subshelves.description: Stops when untrusted text tries to change the job.

subshelves.label: Evidence
subshelves.description: Indexes documents a control asks for. A gap stays a gap.
